source.access: Official indexed text independently checked; complete official PDF retrieved and hashed after freeze. Full PDF remains an ignored research artifact.

bounded_electrical_scope.receiver_detector_profile: Normal local-clock threshold of 11 continuous dominant bit times; precise-clock 9.5-bit alternative is not adopted
bounded_electrical_scope.signal: Transceiver-normalized digital LIN receive line; dominant LOW, recessive HIGH
bounded_electrical_scope.serial_byte: LOW start, eight LSB-first constant bit cells, HIGH stop
bounded_electrical_scope.target_ownership: Receive-only prefix recognition; all target output enables remain zero
bounded_electrical_scope.token_meaning: Experiment acceptance token for a correctly recognized break/sync prefix; not a LIN-prescribed transmitted response
excluded: Physical LIN transceiver and automotive voltages
Optional break superimposed with an already transmitting data byte

timing_and_malformed_contract.matching: A break requires at least 27500 consecutive observable LOW core samples. Raw edge-aligned held-level fixtures preserve that sample count through the existing two-stage frontend. The first matching observation counts as one.
timing_and_malformed_contract.receiver_vs_master: A 12-bit LOW is accepted by the adopted receiver detector but is labeled nonconforming master generation. It is not a mandatory receiver false-positive case.
timing_and_malformed_contract.continuity: Observable HIGH interruptions split LOW runs; separate short runs cannot accumulate into a break.
timing_and_malformed_contract.sync: Acceptance requires independently decoded 0x55 and valid start/stop samples. Wrong byte or LOW stop produces no acceptance token. Constant nominal bit cells are used except explicitly declared malformed pulses.
timing_and_malformed_contract.recovery: A new legal break/sync while awaiting a byte at a separated boundary abandons the incomplete prior header and accepts the new prefix. This includes a first break/delimiter with no sync, followed by a second break/delimiter/sync, and a complete wrong sync byte followed by a fresh prefix.
timing_and_malformed_contract.stale_header: A wrong sync invalidates the old prefix. A later 0x55 without a new qualifying break must not be accepted.
timing_and_malformed_contract.stop_observation: The oracle decodes at nominal bit centers. A public token cannot appear before the stop cell begins; it must be available no later than stop-cell end plus two nominal bit periods. This bounded FIFO-latency window is an experiment criterion, not a LIN-prescribed response deadline.
timing_and_malformed_contract.lifecycle: Reset, abort or disable at core observation 20000 within a 32500-cycle break clears the prior epoch; the remaining LOW is below threshold, so the suffix must not accept. These cases contain no subsequent fresh prefix.
timing_and_malformed_contract.short_delimiter: No mandatory rejection requirement is added for a shorter delimiter; all qualification suffixes use a legal 60-us HIGH delimiter.
timing_and_malformed_contract.upper_bounds: No maximum break or header timeout is invented. The finite trace/drain bound limits the experiment, not accepted protocol duration.
timing_and_malformed_contract.unobservable_pulses: Analog and subcycle pulses invisible to the existing frontend are outside the claim. One-core-cycle HIGH probes are edge-aligned, explicitly held and observable.

host_and_oracle_inputs.setup: Configure while disabled and preload at most four constant FF FIFO bytes before controller traffic. Configuration may compose the existing sampler and timer-start operations. No host timing assistance or configuration writes during traffic.
inputs: Public RX FIFO count/head and externally requested posttraffic reads
forbidden_expected_inputs: Internal primitive firing or timer state
host_and_oracle_inputs.expected_algorithm: An independent maximal-LOW-run scan and LSB-first byte decoder establish qualifying prefixes. Find each long LOW, its release and next falling edge; decode start/data/stop at fixed centers. If a new qualifying break replaces a pending byte, restart at that break. A wrong byte clears the old prefix. Lifecycle cuts invalidate affected epochs. Expected FIFO tokens and windows derive only from that electrical schedule.
host_and_oracle_inputs.observed_algorithm: Observe public FIFO occupancy changes during traffic for early/duplicate acceptance and drain the independently expected number of tokens after a 5000-cycle HIGH margin. Missing/wrong reads, extra occupancy/tokens, output enable, or acceptance outside the preregistered windows fail.
host_and_oracle_inputs.oracle_independence: Oracle author is delegated the committed electrical contract without the configuration or its implementation graph.

acceptance_gate: All 34 cases, independent oracle, full frozen model/RTL agreement and before/after semantic verification. Qualification commands exit nonzero on required failure.
stop_rule: If qualification requires model/RTL semantics, frontend/timer behavior, vocabulary or state changes, preserve the counterexample and stop. No semantic repair, oracle weakening or candidate substitution. Configuration revisions remain allowed under this unchanged contract. Physical work is prohibited until an unseen logical pass.
